title: DanaRS pump: Re-pair needed after change from 26.02.2023
symptom: After a change on 26.02.2023, the DanaRS pump requires re-pairing frequently (twice in 5 days), even during normal operation, which is annoying and disruptive.
cause: The problem is between phone and pump; Dana pumps don't have a way to check if encryption keys are ok, so when the pump doesn't respond, AAPS clears the encryption keys after some attempts, leading to re-pairing.
fix: The code causing the issue was removed (commit f651f721e00b71fd2c5a1bec7f92f4a21a5a12d7). The user eventually switched to Dana-i pump to avoid the issue.
evidence_quote: The problem is between phone and pump. On your place I'd try different phone first Sadly Dana pumps don't have a way to check if encryptions keys are ok. Pump simply doesn't respond. Thus reaction of AAPS to not responding pump (after some attempts) is clearing the encryption keys
